title: Rotary–GEV Collaboration: Exploring Opportunities
summary: President Pranit Naheta, accompanied by Rtn. Kanan Naheta, visited Govardhan EcoVillage (GEV), Palghar, at the invitation of Gauranga Das Prabhu, CEO of GEV.
description:
President Pranit Naheta, accompanied by Rtn. Kanan Naheta, visited Govardhan EcoVillage (GEV), Palghar, at the invitation of Gauranga Das Prabhu, CEO of GEV.

The visit provided an opportunity to interact with the GEV team, undertake a recce of potential project sites and discuss community initiatives that both organisations could jointly pursue, building on their shared commitment to service and sustainability.

One of the key opportunities identified was the development of a dog shelter to address the needs of stray dogs at GEV. Other potential initiatives were also discussed for possible collaboration.

The visit marks an encouraging step towards building a partnership between Rotary Club of Bombay Bayview and Govardhan EcoVillage, with the aim of translating shared ideas into impactful community projects.

Exploring needs. Building partnerships. Creating lasting impact.
